g.id: S1: SUNNY-DAY FAILURE (S1D with dikes, S1N without)
Start: pool at the full supply level 84.5 m. Inflow: none, no rain
Breach: 5 monoliths, 85 m wide, bottom 23 m, formed in 6 min, C = 1.66. Trigger: set time, hour 2
Window 14 h. Sensitivity on this scenario: width 51 and 153 m, formation time 3 and 18 min, C = 1.44
Start: pool at 84.5 m. Inflow: PMF 18,714 m3/s at the dam, J11 and the southern catchment; rain on the plain
Breach: none. Result: maximum pool 96.06 m at hour 15.25, spillway 17,323 m3/s
Window 60 h. Reference for what the failure adds. Also run with the 10,000-year flood
Start: pool at 84.5 m. Inflow: the same PMF and rain as S3
Breach: the same 85 m base breach as S1. Trigger: set time = maximum pool of S3, hour 15.25
Window 60 h. Sensitivity on this scenario: width 119 m, and the 10,000-year flood instead of the PMF
